title: Shut Up and Let Me Play - An Actual Skip Button
summary: Fast-forward is not skip. This restores Crimson Desert's native hold-to-skip control so supported gameplay cutscenes actually end when you hold Skip. No custom overlay, auto-skip, or remapping. Requires an x64 ASI loader.
publication_state: Public GitHub repository created; Nexus page prepared for publication.
